content.title: Oracle SQL Firewall: Database-Native Defense That Catches What WAF Misses

rows: A fintech app (LuminaForge) trusts user input in SQL — attackers inject via search/lookup fields to read other customers' transactions and credentials straight from the database.
Perimeter tools like WAF only read HTTP request text — signature rules are evaded with hex/XML encoding or JSON bodies, and they never see the actual SQL the database executes.
Oracle Database 26ai SQL Firewall enforces an allow-list of expected SQL + session context (IP, OS user, client program) inside the database kernel itself.
Inspects the real, decoded SQL executed — so payloads that bypass WAF signature rules (proven live in this demo) are still caught instantly, with zero app changes or added latency.
Oracle Database 26ai SQL Firewall (core) + Aegis Vault SOC dashboard + LuminaForge attack-surface app. OCI WAF comparison is optional/extended — not required for the core story.
